description:
Rockstar is recruiting for an early-stage, Charlotte-based company building a new data and onboarding platform for multi-unit franchise operators. The client is already working with operators behind brands such as Jersey Mike’s, Dave’s Hot Chicken, Little Caesars, and Marco’s Pizza. 
 
 About the Role
 
 The person in this role will collaborate with operators, learn where their data breaks, and build the integrations and pipelines that get them live with numbers they can trust. They will also design the onboarding system itself, so each new operator goes live faster than the last. There is no playbook yet, so they will build it with the client’s co-founder and CPO, the Customer Success Lead, and the product and engineering teams.
 The person will be joining a team with experience from Palantir, Y Combinator, Techstars, FullStory, and Dell, among others.

 What Matters for This Role
 The candidate is comfortable working inside a customer’s messy data
 The candidate has modeled data for business analytics
 The candidate can explain a data problem to an operator as clearly as to an engineer
 The candidate writes reusable code, so every build makes the platform better for the next customer
 The candidate is comfortable building with AI tools like Claude Code
 The candidate scopes tightly and ships
 The candidate wants to help define what great onboarding looks like at an early-stage company

 What the Client Is Looking For
 The right person will need 2+ years of post-college experience, ideally in data and system integration, plus strong SQL and TypeScript. Forward-deployed, solutions, and implementation engineers fit best, with Palantir-style FDE work as the archetype.

 Bonus
 Experience working with restaurant or franchise data
 Familiarity with Toast, PAR, Xenial, or Qu
 Experience with dbt or ClickHouse

 Location & Compensation
 Charlotte, NC (Onsite)
 Salary + equity
